assessment.question:
### Exercise 15.3: Calculate angles on a straight line

8. In the diagram below, $YZ$ is a straight line with angles labelled above and below it.

Diagram source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/sv-qb-jss1-15-0_056.png

Find the values of $x$ and $y$, giving reasons for your answer. (Remember to check your answers.)
assessment.expected_answer:
All of the angles above $YZ$ add up to $180^{\circ}$:

$$
\begin{align}
15^{\circ} + 141^{\circ} + x & = 180^{\circ}\quad(\text{angles on a straight line}) \\
156^{\circ} + x & = 180^{\circ}\\
x &= 180^{\circ} - 156^{\circ}\\
\therefore x & = 24^{\circ} \\
\end{align}
$$

In the same way, all of the angles below $YZ$ add up to $180^{\circ}$:

$$
\begin{align}
44^{\circ} + y + 45^{\circ} + 75^{\circ} & = 180^{\circ} \quad(\text{angles on a straight line}) \\
164^{\circ} + y  & = 180^{\circ}\\
y & = 180^{\circ} - 164^{\circ}\\
\therefore y & = 16^{\circ} \\
\end{align}
$$

Here is the completed diagram, with all of the angle values labelled:

Completed diagram source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/sv-qb-jss1-15-1_038.png

Check your answers:

$$
\begin{align}
15^{\circ} + 141^{\circ} + 24^{\circ} + 44^{\circ} + 16^{\circ} + 45^{\circ} + 75^{\circ} & = 360^{\circ} \\
\end{align}
$$
